# HOMIE

HOMIE is a tiny home brand for the Algarve, Portugal. The public website is https://www.athomie.pt.

## What HOMIE offers

- A compact architectural timber tiny home for serious small living in the Algarve.
- Approximate model direction: one-bedroom compact living around 27 m2.
- Positioning: timber-built, factory-built, controlled options, delivered complete in scope, designed around Portugal buyer use cases, launching first in the Algarve.
- Audience: people living full-time or part-time in the Algarve who want a higher-quality alternative to cheap chalets or plastic temporary structures. Secondary audience: buyers outside Portugal who need logistics and compliance qualification.

## Important claim boundaries

- HOMIE does not promise planning approval, permits, rental income, transport feasibility, crane access, foundations, or final price before scope and site assumptions are checked.
- Energy, airtightness, insulation, engineering, and health claims should stay tied to verified documentation.
- CGI images are illustrative location studies and not finished customer case studies unless explicitly marked as verified.

## Key website sections

- Model: core model specifications and buyer-fit proof points.
- Configurator: limited option choices for exterior, kitchen, construction, and terrace direction.
- Realistic use cases: same tiny home shown in different Portugal buyer locations.
- Technology: timber construction layers and engineering questions.
- Process: configure, receive quote, site check, factory build, delivery planning, handover.
- Included and excluded scope: what belongs in the first conversation.
- Lead form: brochure request and buyer qualification.
- FAQ: first-contact questions about customization, land, price, chalets, rental use, included scope, and non-Portugal orders.
